comparator.name: Religious Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: The current catalogue confirms 60 EC of first-year courses for September 2026 entrants, taught in Dutch and English. The first-year study advice requires 45 EC and passing both Source-Based Research and Religion in the World. The catalogue labels the displayed second-year programme for 2025–2026 entrants. Its third-year structure describes 30 EC of open study, 10 EC required study, a 5 EC advanced choice and a 15 EC thesis and seminar together. The current regulations require passing Source-Based Research before Qualitative Research and completing the first two years and thesis seminar for the thesis. The revised later-year requirements and their application to the thesis pathway for September 2026 entrants still need confirmation.
